_about: Scorer FAIL lines the RoboGoat author has already looked at. facts.mjs prints these as one quiet 'known' line; anything not listed prints as NEW. week: the week the scorer was run for. pattern: a regex over the FAIL line. count: the number the line opens with, so a second case in the same week is NEW.
